notes.title: Hotfix 3/15/2023
notes.notes:
Now You can choose to enable or disable the function in the store (Electric Sheep, Wardrobe Stash)

Fixed some text errors.

notes.title: Hotfix 11/23/2022
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue that the regional format will cause the inability to start the combat.
Fixed some text errors.

notes.title: Hotfix 11/18/2022
notes.notes:
Fix the issue that using Dream Bubble to Misty Lake do not work properly.
Fix the issue that skills with summation do not work when changing equipments in battle.
Fix the issue that loading existing progress leads to a scene error in Final Stage.
Fix the issue that Boss Building do not display properly in Final Stage.
Fix the issue that Boss battle camera do not work properly in Final Stage.
Fix the issue that sometimes background music does not play in random sequence.
Fix some text issues.

notes.title: Hotfix 11/16/2022
notes.notes:
Fix the issue that building combo cannot be unlocked. Add the description of building combos conditions  to the Dream Diary.
Fix the issue that event description cannot be displayed completely.
Fix the issue that the Dream Souls player get and levels number cannot be displayed completely.
Fix the issue that the number of landmarks can be more than limitation.
Fix the issue that it may indicate that former dialogues have not been read.
Fix the issue that the game gets stuck when choose Japanese as the display language.
Add the graphic settings of RenderScale and TargetFPS.
